LanguageData.LP_MindFlayer.label: mind flayer
LanguageData.LP_MindFlayer.description: An octopus-headed psionic predator that feeds on the brains of intelligent creatures. Mind flayers don't reproduce and don't pass the bloodline to descendants: new mind flayers can only grow from a tadpole parasitizing a humanlike's brain through "ceremorphosis". Their minds are extremely keen, they learn very fast and see in the dark, but they fear sunlight, are fragile, look horrifying and are poor at socializing. Mind flayers live on "brain matter": it drains daily and must be replenished by devouring brains; when it runs out they fall into brain hunger.
LanguageData.LP_MindFlayer.descriptionShort: A non-inheritable psionic predator. Devours brains to replenish brain matter, can stun enemies with a psychic blast; extremely keen mind, quick learner, night vision; fears sunlight, fragile, ugly, sterile.
